observed_outcome: Formal 600s measurement run on PostgreSQL 18.6 processed 123,016 events across 20 streams with 4 producers and 2 relays. Sustained worst 10s window was 202.40 events/s (exceeding required >= 200.0 events/s threshold for full 600s duration). All correctness checks PASSED under load (0 lost: 123,016/123,016, 0 duplicates: 123,016/123,016 distinct, strictly contiguous per-stream offsets, 20/20 full rebuild projection state hash parity, 0 gaps detected). Storage and WAL write rates demonstrated constant stability across the run (first 60s: 1839.2 B/evt table growth, 3499.9 B/evt WAL; last 60s: 1840.9 B/evt table growth, 3089.1 B/evt WAL). R7-1, R7-2, and R7-3 resolved.
